liquidity_sweep.mechanism: prior-extreme stop/liquidity sweep followed by closed-bar reclaim; the payer is forced/late liquidity taking around clustered stops and failed continuation
liquidity_sweep.entry: sweep of prior 20-bar extreme plus reclaim on the same closed bar
liquidity_sweep.regime_no_trade: no trade without unambiguous sweep+reclaim; stale/missing/duplicate/cost authority fail closed
liquidity_sweep.risk: initial structural ATR stop; no adverse add; no pyramiding
liquidity_sweep.execution_cost: verified round-trip cost required before intent can become tradable
liquidity_sweep.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed-entry controls and cost-budget failure

scalp_snap.mechanism: large one-bar impulse followed by immediate opposite closed-bar snap with elevated activity; the payer is late aggressive flow during a failed impulse
scalp_snap.entry: impulse >=0.9 ATR followed by reversal >=0.4 ATR and volume confirmation
scalp_snap.regime_no_trade: no trade without reversal and volume confirmation; stale/missing/duplicate/cost authority fail closed
scalp_snap.risk: ATR stop; short timeout; no add/pyramiding/runner
scalp_snap.execution_cost: verified realistic round-trip cost is mandatory and structural cost budget must clear minimum
scalp_snap.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed-entry controls and cost-budget failure

vol_spike_fade.mechanism: abnormal volume plus directional range expansion can mark short-lived exhaustion; the payer is late momentum flow when continuation fails
vol_spike_fade.entry: closed-bar >=2x recent volume with >=0.75 ATR directional body, fading the spike under a trend-stretch veto
vol_spike_fade.regime_no_trade: no trade when spike is absent, trend stretch is extreme, or source/cost authority is invalid
vol_spike_fade.risk: ATR stop; no water-add/scale-in/pyramiding; no evaluator-invented exits
vol_spike_fade.execution_cost: verified round-trip cost required; cost budget checked before entry
failure_modes: mean-reversion horizon too short after costs
vol_spike_fade.falsification: direction flip/time placebo/delayed-entry controls and cost-budget failure
